name: What is the difference between water damage restoration and sewage cleanup?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between water damage restoration and sewage cleanup?

acceptedAnswer.text: While both involve water, sewage cleanup (Category 3 water damage) involves highly contaminated water containing human waste, bacteria, viruses, and other hazardous materials, posing severe health risks. Water damage restoration (Category 1 or 2) deals with clean or grey water, which carries fewer immediate health threats. Sewage cleanup requires specialized containment, personal protective equipment, and advanced disinfection protocols not typically needed for clean water damage to ensure safety.
acceptedAnswer.description: Sewage cleanup handles highly contaminated water with severe health risks, requiring specialized protocols beyond standard water damage restoration.
